findings.baselineReproduction: An actual renderer failing after one successful frame produced automatic retry delays [2000,2000,2000], replenishing the budget on every looping state.
findings.fix: Automatic retry budget survives momentary looping/static; manual retry or a new online event resets it.
findings.currentNodeRegression: scripts/tests/test_scene_lifecycle.mjs passed: [2000,5000,null], three created/destroyed instances; online resets a fresh budget; final timers/rAF/listeners zero.

findings.baselineReproduction: Original regex inventory used word-boundary id/src and global charset replacement; security agent independently fixed ownership/HTML-state ambiguity. Cross-review also confirmed template-counted scripts and body charset acceptance in the first tokenizer draft, plus raw CRLF hashes mismatching normalized HTML text.
findings.fix: Restricted tokenizer handles exact attributes/quoted >, comments/raw text, rejects inert templates and unsupported/malformed states, requires literal html/head/UTF8 envelope, and normalizes only hash-input line endings.
findings.currentIndependentEvidence: 12 current CSP tests passed; separate Node probes reject template/body/fakehead/data-id/data-src, allow quoted >, and verify normalized CRLF hash.
findings.limitation: Trusted production format guard, not a general HTML sanitizer. Current shipped baseline content was trusted; no visitor-triggerable exploit is claimed.
